note: args = [Markdown text, query text, options {regex, caseSensitive}]; expected = {outline, hits}. outline has one line for each tree node, indented by depth: '*' marks a hit, '-' a context line, headings start with their # signs and hits are wrapped in <<>>. Expected values are written by hand. A hit counts one for each matching line. Only the fields present are compared.
